{{Quote|Thanks for the rescue, Master Plo.|Adi Gallia|<ref name="Nomad Droids" />}}
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] launched a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] mission to '''rescue''' [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], who had been previously [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna/Legends|captured]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. After locating Grievous's [[Grievous's Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Patitite Pattuna)/Legends|flagship]] in [[Realspace/Legends|space]], Koon took a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of five [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Republic Star Destroyers]] to [[Space warfare/Legends|ambush]] the Separatist [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]]. Boarding Grievous's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] with the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic Grand Army's]] [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion]], Koon and his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] fought through the [[Warship/Legends|warship's]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] defenders while [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]], nicknamed "Wolffe," took a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] to rescue Gallia from the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]. Grievous was forced to flee from his overwhelmed flagship, allowing Wolffe to rescue Gallia. The Republic emerged victorious, while Koon and Wolffe also retrieved the Republic [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], who had been stranded on Grievous's flagship after a series of escapades.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|General, we've come across what appears to be a pirate ship.''"<br />"''Use that ship for target practice. Open fire!|A B1 battle droid is ordered by Grievous to target the ''Marauder''|<ref name="Nomad Droids" />}}
[[File:KoonFleetRescue-ND.png|thumb|left|250px|Plo Koon's fleet of Star Destroyers arrives to rescue Gallia from Grievous's destroyer.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] gained notoriety for targeting members of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="The Deserter">{{TCW|The Deserter}}</ref> Such was the case<ref name="Nomad Droids" /> in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> when he [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna/Legends|ambushed]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia's]] [[Adi Gallia's flagship/Legends|flagship]] near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Patitite Pattuna]]. Gallia's [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] was crippled in the [[Space warfare/Legends|assault]], and she was [[Prisoner/Legends|taken into custody]] aboard Grievous's [[Grievous's Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Patitite Pattuna)/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] while her [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] was destroyed.<ref name="Nomad Droids" />

It was not long before [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], a fellow member of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], received word of Gallia's capture and set out to rescue his comrade. Commanding a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of five ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], Koon located Grievous's [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] in [[Realspace/Legends|space]], just after Grievous had ordered his [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] crew to attack the [[Weequay pirate ship/Legends|Weequay pirate ship]] [[Marauder (Weequay pirate ship)/Legends|''Marauder'']] for target practice. The [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], both belonging to Republic [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], were aboard the ''Marauder'' at the [[Time/Legends|time]] that it was targeted by Grievous. Although they managed to escape from the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] destruction, they were forced to come aboard Grievous's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] and were subsequently set to be [[Incinerator (weapon)||incinerated]] into scrap metal for the Confederacy.<ref name="Nomad Droids" />

==The rescue==
{{Quote|General Grievous has fled.''"<br />"''Very good! Finish off the remaining droids.|Wolffe and Plo Koon|<ref name="Nomad Droids" />}}
[[File:GalliaRescued-ND.png|thumb|right|250px|Rescued by Wolffe, Gallia joins Koon and his 104th troops in combating the battle droids.]]
Immediately after emerging from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] near Grievous's [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]], Koon's five-cruiser fleet of Star Destroyers began to exchange heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire with the Separatist [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]]. The Republic fleet quickly gained the upper hand, launching [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighters]] and [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] to challenge the destroyer's defenses. The [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilots]] moved in with their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and assaulted the enemy [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]], hitting several places along its [[Hull/Legends|hull]]. Koon was thus able to board the destroyer with a rescue team, taking the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion]] to push through the Separatist battle [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces. While Koon and his men from the 104th [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] fought [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] in one of the vessel's hallways, [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]], nicknamed "Wolffe," took another squad of [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], where Gallia was being held in custody.<ref name="Nomad Droids" />

Wolffe and his men were successful, rescuing Gallia from the Separatists, and they rendezvoused with Koon to join his fight against the battle droids. Between the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and the [[Cloning/Legends|clones']] [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], they were able to defeat the squad of droids. His droid [[Troop/Legends|troops]] overwhelmed, Grievous fled from his flagship, leaving the Republic forces to eliminate the remainder of the battle droids aboard the Separatist [[Warship/Legends|warship]].<ref name="Nomad Droids" />

==Aftermath==
{{Dialogue|C-3PO|Commander Wolffe. How have you been, sir? We have been on quite an adventure.|Plo Koon|Well, I'm certain Wolffe would ''love'' to hear about it.|Wolffe|Uh, actually, sir&hellip;|C-3PO|Excellent! It's a long story.|attr=C-3PO, Plo Koon, and Wolffe|src=<ref name="Nomad Droids" />}}
[[File:AfterTheRescue-ND.png|thumb|right|250px|C-3PO, newly rescued alongside R2-D2, speaks to Wolffe, Koon, and Gallia.]]
The mission was a success for the Republic due to Koon's rescue of Gallia. The wayward C-3PO and R2-D2&mdash;having avoided being incinerated by the Separatists&mdash;were also rescued, coming upon Wolffe, Gallia, and Koon while aboard Grievous's destroyer. Having delivered the two droids earlier to Gallia's flagship from the planet [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]], Wolffe could not believe it when he and the others found the droids aboard the Separatist dreadnaught, though Wolffe was less than pleased when the talkative C-3PO began thoroughly recounting their adventures since escaping from Gallia's ship.<ref name="Nomad Droids" />

==Behind the scenes==
The rescue of Adi Gallia was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series and was featured in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] episode "[[Nomad Droids]]," which aired on [[October 14]], [[2011]].<ref name="Explore: Nomad Droids">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/nomad-droids-episode-guide|text="Nomad Droids" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> Because of a lack of information presented in the episode,<ref name="Nomad Droids" /> a specific location for the battle cannot be determined beyond being in space.
